categories.main_business_segments: Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical manufacturing industry focusing on wet-process phosphoric acid production. Its main business segments include production and sales of feed-grade phosphate additives, fertilizers (notably heavy and rich calcium phosphate), purified phosphoric acid for industrial and food use, and new energy materials such as lithium iron phosphate for batteries. The company also engages in research and development of related chemical and new energy materials technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes wet-process phosphoric acid technology, including semi-water and dihydrate methods, combined with proprietary flotation techniques for low to medium-grade phosphate ore beneficiation. It has developed advanced phosphoric acid extraction and purification technologies, enabling production of food-grade purified phosphoric acid. The firm also integrates sulfuric acid production from pyrite and comprehensive utilization of by-products like phosphogypsum and fluorosilicic acid. Its new energy materials segment focuses on lithium iron phosphate battery materials using proprietary carbon coating and synthesis methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic and international feed producers, fertilizer manufacturers, and industrial users in food, pharmaceutical, and new energy sectors. The company serves agricultural markets with phosphate fertilizers and feed additives, aquaculture with high-efficiency feed-grade phosphates, and the battery industry with lithium iron phosphate materials. Major export markets cover South America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, while domestic sales focus on large group customers and distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China, with production bases in Kunming (Yunnan Province) and Guangxi (Fangchenggang). The company exports globally, with significant sales in South America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for chemical product import-export and trade facilitation. Domestic sales cover multiple Chinese regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the phosphate chemical supply chain, processing phosphate ore into phosphoric acid and phosphate salts. It sources raw phosphate minerals and sulfuric acid, manufactures intermediate and finished chemical products, and supplies downstream industries such as agriculture, feed, food, pharmaceuticals, and battery manufacturing. The company also integrates upstream beneficiation and downstream product purification and value-added processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in wet-process phosphoric acid purification, flotation beneficiation of low-grade phosphate ore, and comprehensive utilization of by-products to enhance resource efficiency and reduce costs. It is expanding R&D in new energy materials, particularly lithium iron phosphate battery cathode materials, aiming to become a leading supplier in the electrochemical and phosphate chemical sectors. R&D investments increased by over 37% in 2024, focusing on environmental technologies, product quality improvement, and new product development aligned with green and sustainable industry trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including feed-grade phosphate additives, phosphate fertilizers, purified phosphoric acid, and new energy materials. Sales channels include direct sales to large domestic and international customers and distributor networks. The company also earns government subsidies and engages in cash management of idle funds. Revenue is recognized at the point of transfer of control of goods, with export sales recognized upon shipment and customs clearance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading wet-process phosphoric acid producer in China, with technology and product quality on par with industry leaders. Domestic competitors in phosphate fertilizers and feed additives include Yunnan Xiangfeng, Sanhuan Zhonghua, Guizhou Phosphate Chemical, and Hubei Xiangyun. In purified phosphoric acid, competitors include Guizhou Phosphate Chemical, Yuntianhua, Liuguo Chemical, Xingfa Group, and Chuanhua Group. The company leverages flexible production lines and integrated resource utilization to maintain cost and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.21 billion, an 18.3% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by phosphoric acid sales growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 176 million, a turnaround from a loss in 2023, reflecting improved market conditions and cost control. Total assets stood at RMB 3.61 billion with equity of RMB 2.54 billion. The company’s asset-liability ratio was 28.11%, indicating a stable financial structure. R&D expenditure increased by 37.5% to RMB 121 million, supporting future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary wet-process phosphoric acid purification technology enabling food-grade product quality, flexible production lines allowing rapid product mix adjustments, and comprehensive resource utilization reducing costs and environmental impact. Its phosphate products have high purity and bioavailability, meeting stringent feed and fertilizer standards. The integration of phosphate chemical production with new energy materials development positions the company to capture growth in emerging battery markets. Strong international customer relationships and logistics advantages further enhance its competitive edge.
